entries.duty: Calculates financial summaries from supplied figures; the API test independently checks gross margin and point charging.
entries.limit: Does not establish real-time bank integration or every financial metric’s correctness.

entries.duty: Accepts declared dimensions, rejects unknown dimensions and charges only an accepted run.
entries.limit: Does not establish the accuracy of the business diagnosis or the full Strategic Identity Statement promise.

entries.duty: Computes a quote from the recorded job budget range.
entries.limit: Deterministic budget arithmetic; not market-price validation.

entries.duty: Returns the recorded lower/upper budget range for the job.
entries.limit: Not a verified delivery-cost forecast.

entries.duty: Invoices approved milestones using the exact recorded amount.
entries.limit: Actual payment collection is a separate provider-dependent operation.

entries.duty: Converts using the stored rate; handles same currency and rejects missing pairs.
entries.limit: Display-only indicative conversion; no claim of live exchange-rate freshness.

entries.duty: Persists a generated asset, lists it, creates revisions and removes the version chain.
entries.limit: Concurrent editing and immutable retention are separate acceptance concerns.

entries.duty: Exports a completed document as a PDF and rejects another workspace’s access.
entries.limit: Tests verify valid PDF header/access; not visual layout of every possible document.

entries.duty: Records a signer and a content-hash-bound attestation.
entries.limit: An in-app attestation; not a qualified electronic signature.

entries.duty: Applies block/ask/allow rules, version-bound approval, tenant/principal checks, pause/expiry, bounded retry and restart recovery.
entries.limit: Verified built-in runtime behavior; not every canonical workflow/connector/compensation capability.

entries.duty: Creates, lists, updates and deletes tasks for project parties.
entries.limit: This does not independently certify all assignment/edit concurrency edge cases.

entries.duty: Surfaces overdue or blocked open tasks and excludes completed tasks.
entries.limit: Computed attention feed; not continuous external notifications.

entries.duty: Allows parties to request changes and only the owner to decide them; rejects a repeated decision.
entries.limit: Approval recording does not itself prove every downstream scope/money effect.

entries.duty: Persists the project–milestone–deliverable–submission–review–approval sequence and checks client/freelancer roles.
entries.limit: Content verification in this test does not certify actual external artifact quality.

entries.duty: Creates a dispute record and changes the milestone to disputed.
entries.limit: Resolution fairness and actual funds recovery require separate validation.

entries.duty: Requires fully paid milestones before closing and issuing the completion certificate.
entries.limit: Uses test-controlled payment state; not evidence of live settlement.

entries.duty: Stores ordered messages between project parties and rejects unrelated accounts.
entries.limit: No claim of delivery to external chat/email providers.

entries.duty: Produces family-appropriate steps while retaining supplied success conditions and constraints.
entries.limit: Template behavior; not validation of live AI advice.

entries.duty: Starts a goal at captured and enforces allowed lifecycle transitions and terminal states.
entries.limit: The broader dependency/change-propagation contract is separate.

entries.duty: Creates, lists and removes goal subscriptions.
entries.limit: This does not certify matching relevance, constraint enforcement or continuous scanning.

entries.duty: Reads fresh stored results and excludes expired results; rejects other-workspace access.
entries.limit: Not certification of the full typed result/lineage fabric.

entries.duty: Flags different conclusions for the same subject for human review.
entries.limit: A conflict flag is not automatic evidence reconciliation.

entries.duty: Persists an advisor recommendation and accepts it; stage changes invalidate linked stale results/recommendations.
entries.limit: Execution scheduling, causal validity and ordinary edit/delete propagation need their own proof.

entries.duty: Starts a saved scope from an objective without requiring all fields first.
entries.limit: Qualified review/publication and resume UX are separate.

entries.duty: Returns Explain, Example, Suggest and Help-me-decide responses and rejects unsupported fields/strangers.
entries.limit: Tests prove the contract and non-destructive suggestions, not expert-quality reasoning.

entries.duty: Stores distinct attributed snapshots on successive saves.
entries.limit: Does not certify simultaneous edits or expert proposal reconciliation.

entries.duty: Computes an SLA from declared availability and leaves it absent when none is declared.
entries.limit: This does not prove qualification, deadline monitoring or delivery within that SLA.

entries.duty: Creates and updates a profile.
entries.limit: Profile persistence does not verify credentials or eligibility.

entries.duty: Grades the supported quiz banks deterministically and rejects unsupported skills.
entries.limit: Limited to supported assessments, not all professions.

entries.duty: Grants a package to the engaged expert, resolves it, rejects foreign objects and blocks resolution after revocation.
entries.limit: Expiry, purpose and broader delegation semantics are separate.

entries.duty: Copies records or grants revocable reference/promote pointers between permitted workspaces.
entries.limit: The anonymize operation is not certified to remove identifying information.

entries.duty: Creates paths/modules, tracks module completion and blocks enrollment until prerequisites are met.
entries.limit: Completion/score tracking is not independently verified mastery.

entries.duty: Assigns paths with due dates and restricts compliance requirement creation to administrators.
entries.limit: Does not establish organization-wide compliance certification.

entries.duty: Creates KPI definitions, records observations, lists and deletes them.
entries.limit: Does not certify metric source quality or causal impact.

entries.duty: Creates, changes pipeline status and deletes opportunities.
entries.limit: Not certification of goal-aware opportunity discovery.

entries.duty: Enforces draft → running → complete transitions.
entries.limit: Not validation of experiment design/statistical conclusions.

entries.duty: Creates a persisted draft experiment.
entries.limit: AI-generated hypothesis quality is not certified.

entries.duty: Includes actual stored KPI data in the analytics context.
entries.limit: Not independent validation of live model conclusions.

entries.duty: Includes actual stored opportunity pipeline data.
entries.limit: Not validation of continuous external signal monitoring.

entries.duty: Rejects unknown permissions, bounds feature/cost/source access and rejects an AI result when policy changes during the request.
entries.limit: Tests use controlled providers; full cross-service lane governance is separate.

entries.duty: Debits successful runs, refunds failed runs and rejects insufficient balance.
entries.limit: Not certification of fiat ledger retention or settlement.

entries.duty: Grounds its input in the real job, rejects unrelated users and persists the resulting draft.
entries.limit: Provider-controlled tests do not establish live writing or commercial quality.

entries.duty: Uses the real job and rejects unrelated users.
entries.limit: Complete scoping/review requirements are broader.

entries.duty: Uses the real job and rejects unrelated users.
entries.limit: No legal correctness or enforceability certification.

entries.duty: Uses the real proposal and rejects unrelated users.
entries.limit: No live drafting-quality or downstream commitment certification.
